title: Azure Backup
description: Protect your data with Azure Backup — simple, secure cloud backup service with hybrid solutions designed to keep your business running and data safe.

sections.title: Enterprise-grade data protection
bullets: Monitor, operate, govern, and plan backups at scale with resiliency capabilities in Azure.

Protect your backups from ransomware attacks with air-gapped vaults and ensure cyber resilience with key features like immutability, soft-delete, and multiuser authorization (MUA). Backup data is always encrypted at-rest and in-transit with a choice to bring your own encryption keys.

Safeguard a diverse range of traditional and cloud-native workloads, including data-transfer intensive and mission-critical databases like SQL Server, SAP HANA, PostgreSQL, and MySQL; storage solutions like Azure blobs, file shares, and others; and containerized applications running in Microsoft Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) clusters.
Eliminate extra costs of additional backup infrastructure and overhead for scaling and managing storage. Gain insights on your backup estate with Azure Backup reports.

sections.title: Protect your assets from ransomware
bullets: Manage and monitor all your infrastructure data from a unified control plane in Azure.

Store data in Recovery Services vaults to isolate your backups from production systems, with that data always encrypted at rest with an option of customer-managed keys. Monitor controls that strengthen cyber resilience and help meet key regulatory requirements like identity protection, data retention, and secure recovery.

Control and prevent unauthorized access with Azure role-based access control and MUA. Ensure backups are always recoverable against any destructive actions with the Immutable vault setting which provides built-in security alerts that notify you of any critical operations happening in your vaults.

Store your backup data across different Azure regions and availability zones to ensure business continuity. Maintain six copies of data across two paired Azure regions with geo-redundant storage (GRS).
Recover data during outages or as needed using cross-region restore and recover data to a different subscription with cross-subscription restore.
Automatically move your long-term retention data to archive-tier storage and save on costs.

bullets: Azure Cosmos DB is a fully managed, cloud-native NoSQL database designed to deliver ultra-low latency and elastic scalability at a global scale. sections.title: Reliable, low-cost storage for long-term data preservation
bullets: Exponential data growth doesn’t have to mean exponential costs for data storage and management. Azure Archive Storage offers low-cost, durable, and highly available secure cloud storage for rarely accessed data with flexible latency requirements. Store terabytes of data in the cloud for only a few dollars a month, and repurpose your storage infrastructure for other critical business objectives.

Rarely accessed doesn’t mean unimportant. Many industries require that organizations maintain multiple years of sensitive financial, medical, or employee data. When you move that data to the cloud, you want it to be protected with the highest level of security. Archive Storage provides secure data transfer to the cloud using HTTPS, and automatically secures that data at rest using 256-bit AES keys.

Azure Archive Storage is yet another storage tier available for blob storage. Hot, cool, and archive objects can all exist side by side in the same account. And with the introduction of blob-level tiering, you can change an object’s tier with a single click in the Azure portal, or you can use the REST API (or .NET, Java, Python, and a number of other SDKs) to programmatically change as many objects as needed.

sections.title: Archive Storage Use Cases
bullets: Many organizations retain multi-year, PB sized collections of Server and Desktop data backups and store them on expensive storage arrays. Azure Archive Storage provides a secure, low-cost means for retaining those backups and freeing up storage capacity for other productive uses.

Companies can generate PB’s of data in the course of day to day operations and to meet legal compliance requirements. Company policies often dictate that this data (sensitive HR records, email, financial/tax records) is retained in perpetuity. Archive Storage can work with Smart Archiving offerings from ISV’s to create a low cost, content archiving solution.

Healthcare providers are increasingly required to retain patient medical record data for multi-year periods. Storage requirements for patient data can quickly escalate when the records include high resolution images and ultrasound content. Azure Archive storage enables Healthcare providers to lower their storage costs while providing secure, globally compliant storage for sensitive medical data.

Maintaining tape storage infrastructure is expensive and often requires specialized equipment and expertise. Archive Storage is a cost-effective, low maintenance replacement alternative for tape storage.

Creators can generate PB’s worth of video and picture content that is used in the development of original digital media. Archive Storage gives creators a low-cost storage repository for original source content. Blob-level tiering makes it easy to shift from cold to hot storage should the need arise to use that content for another project.

As the number and sophistication of threats to personal and business safety continue to increase, so does the demand for video surveillance. Public and now private sector companies generate TB’s of surveillance footage daily in the course of protecting their citizens and assets. Archive Storage is a low cost option for storing that data.
